sentences.en: He had to commute to work at his first job.
sentences.zh: 他在第一份工作时需要上下班往返。

sentences.en: I have to commute all the way from a distant suburb.
sentences.zh: 我必须从远郊通勤过来。

sentences.en: The new highway shaves almost an hour off my commute time.
sentences.zh: 新高速公路使我的通勤时间缩短了将近一个小时。

senses.zh: 减刑；交换；用……交换；使……变成
